title: Hearty Creamy Mediterranean Fish Stew
description: A comforting Mediterranean fish stew with a sweet and creamy sauce, flavored with fennel seeds, and low in carbs.

ingredients.name: Cod Fillets
ingredients.notes: Fresh, deboned, and cut into 2-inch pieces

instructions: In a large pot, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat and sauté the chopped fennel bulb until slightly softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the deboned cod fillets, chopped oregano, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 3 minutes, until the fish starts to change color.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 8 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Stir in the crumbled Feta cheese and cook for 1 minute, until melted.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt and lemon juice.
Stir the yogurt-lemon mixture into the pot and cook for 2 minutes, until heated through.
Remove the pot from the heat and stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter.
Let the stew rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the fish stew hot, garnished with additional chopped oregano if desired.
